title: Domain specific multimodal large language model for automated endoscopy reporting with multicenter prospective validation
summary: A multimodal LLM generated endoscopy reports and was prospectively evaluated across centres; accuracy was comparable to junior endoscopists and below senior experts.
ai_technology: Report-Angel combines a multimodal large language model with conventional deep-learning models to generate upper-gastrointestinal endoscopy reports.
